correctness.rationale: After affine normalization, conditioning on the interior atoms shows that interior conditional variance can only increase the Bhatia--Davis efficiency at fixed interior mean. The remaining three-level problem reduces by an odds substitution to a one-variable arithmetic--geometric mean inequality with the stated unique equality geometry. Distinct positive interior atoms make the lower endpoint unattainable beyond three atoms, the classical deficit makes the upper endpoint strict, and connectedness supplies every intermediate value. Independent exact-rational random tests verified the radical-free lower certificate and the strict upper bound.
